a.text: Shigefumi Mori became past president of the Union.

b.text: Shigefumi Mori became president of the International Mathematical Union.

a.text: Shigefumi Mori's term as past president of the Union ended.
The IMU's Commission for Developing Countries (CDC) released an update of the report.

b.text: IMU released the report The International Mathematical Union in the Developing World: Past, Present and Future.

a.text: The first woman president of the International Mathematical Union was noted in August 2010.
